sourceChecks.text: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: 本文がアヒノアムをダビデの妻、イズレエル人として挙げる。

sourceChecks.text: Sons were born to David in Hebron. His firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
sourceChecks.readingNoteJa: アヒノアムの子アムノンがダビデの長子と記される。
